newspaper.headline: Update Season Arrives
newspaper.lead: Many security updates were released this month. The IT Workshop reminds employees not to put off updates and to install apps only from the company App Portal.

impact.good: Yesterday, network complaints at Nusa Digital were handled correctly. The floor 4 outage was quickly passed to the network team.
impact.mixed: Yesterday, most network complaints were solved, but some were misdiagnosed. A few employees still can't open work sites.
impact.bad: Yesterday, many network complaints were handled wrongly. Several teams had to work without internet until the afternoon.

tip.title: Tip: Updates Are Patches
tip.text: Security updates close holes that attackers already know about. Save your work, install the update, then restart.

newspaper.classified: FREE: Plenty of disk space for anyone willing to empty their Downloads folder.

boss.title: Mass Update
boss.intro: After a big update, reports pour in together. Not every problem means something is broken.
